Account overview: CrowQuay Ops runs regional control centers for potable water and wastewater SCADA in two states. Highly regulated — cannot accept outbound model calls to public cloud for production telemetry or PII-enriched logs. Looking for private on-prem package that can be installed in air-gapped enclaves and integrates with existing HSM and SIEM.

Key sellers' notes:
- Primary use: incident triage + automated runbook suggestion from engineering runbooks and historical incident tickets. Also looking at faster operator search across SOP docs (reranking) and summarization for shift handovers.
- Latency/throughput: 100 concurrent operator sessions during incidents, median response <500ms for short prompts, background batch scoring for nightly rerank jobs acceptable.
- Cost sensitivity: high — procurement prefers fixed term reserved capacity license instead of per-token usage.
- Model preference: open, LLMs that can be quantized; need ability to pin reproducible model versions and exportable weights for air-gapped install.
- Routing/fallback: must support local fallback model when enclave disconnected; no outbound fallbacks permitted for production.
- Security: SSO via SAML to existing IdP, hardware-backed key storage (HSM) for model encryption keys, audit logging to Splunk, 7-year retention for incident transcripts per regulator.
